node.statement: Fix a datum, n, and write h_n=(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n and b_n=||h_n||. The Ha-map is linear between the finite-dimensional amplified corner and an operator algebra, hence b_n is finite. For T=h_n(Z), the operator C*-identity gives ||T||^2=||T^dagger T||, and lem-hcb2-amplified-adjointness gives T^dagger=h_n(Z^dagger).
